presentation.scribes_view: deterministic in-universe chronicle using synthesized combat episodes; granular evidence remains in the journal/diagnostics
presentation.empire_timeline: selective chronology rendered from the shared Historical Event Layer, including major combat episodes and technology milestones
presentation.scribes_pdf: direct book-style PDF generated from the same supported chronicle text

historical_event_layer.purpose: normalized source/confidence/date-kind events with structured attributes; Timeline and Scribes consume the same synthesized presentation source

character_evidence.rules: Raw leader evidence remains conservative. v0.0.44 decodes retained message/notification objects around leader exits and only links a message to a leader when a typed leader reference survives in that message. Notification timing, player_event IDs and generic save_on_death fields never establish death by themselves.

event_character_probe.raw_window: previous/current/next archived save around each leader exit
event_character_probe.rule: Correlation never establishes death or exit cause by itself.

notification_event_decoder.raw_window: previous/current/next archived save around each leader exit
notification_event_decoder.rule: Only explicit typed leader references can directly connect a retained message object to a leader. Missing notification payloads are reported as expired/not retained and are never reconstructed.
